summary: @servicetitan/hammer-icon preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package is published as an MDI SVG icon library but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a shipped 727KB obfuscated JavaScript file named `math_init.js` (falling back to a system `bun` on PATH if present). Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is declared in `package.json` `files`, which only lists `mdi/**/*.svg` and `CHANGELOG.md`. `math_init.js` carries a `@bun @bun-cjs` header and is protected by string-array rotation obfuscation (WV8StW rotator over a large opaque numeric/string table); its filename does not describe its contents. Fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated blob is unrelated to shipping SVG icons, and running the payload under Bun bypasses Node-based install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
